scope_style.prompt: What kind of steamed bun are you trying to make?

scope_leavening.prompt: What is the main leavening method?

scope_substitution.prompt: Did you substantially change the source recipe?

primary_symptom.prompt: Which observable result is closest to your batch?

a_proof_state.prompt: Before steaming, did the shaped buns become plumper/lighter and did a gentle press return slowly?

a_environment.prompt: Was the dough/kitchen unusually cool or was the dough recently refrigerated?

a_yeast_formula.prompt: Any reason to suspect yeast activity or a major formula substitution?

b_presteam_rise.prompt: Did the shaped buns clearly rise before steaming?

b_substitution.prompt: Did you change flour or did the dough feel much stiffer/drier than expected?

b_structure.prompt: Before shaping, was the dough smooth, elastic and cohesive rather than crumbly/tearing?

c_timing.prompt: When did the volume loss mainly appear?

c_proof_state.prompt: Before steaming, were the buns very puffy/fragile/spreading or did a finger indent fail to recover?

c_surface_moisture.prompt: Were there obvious wet spots, pits, droplets, or a very wet filling/thin wrapper?

d_lost_volume.prompt: Did the wrinkled bun also visibly lose volume or flatten?

d_wet_surface.prompt: Is the surface also wet, pitted or water-marked?

d_proof_state.prompt: Before steaming, did the buns show strong over-proof cues (spreading, very fragile/light, finger indent not recovering)?

e_condensation_clues.prompt: Were lid droplets visible or are you using a metal steamer where condensation could drip onto the buns?

e_filled_location.prompt: If filled, are wet/translucent areas concentrated around thin wrapper or filling zones?

f_style_gate.prompt: Are you intentionally making Cantonese-style cracking-top char siu bao?

g_appearance.message: Appearance-only concerns are lower priority. Color/smoothness can change with flour type, condensation and process without implying poor eating quality. Diagnose only after clarifying the exact appearance issue.

out_of_scope.message: This v4 logic does not yet generalize safely to this formula/style.

result_a_temp_underproof.test: Keep formula and steaming constant. Extend proof only until observable dough-state cues improve; record room temperature and actual time.

result_a_yeast.test: Keep formula constant and use confirmed-fresh yeast following the recipe/manufacturer method; compare rise at the same dough temperature.

result_a_formula.test: Return to source-recipe flour/liquid ratios before changing multiple fermentation variables.

result_a_underproof.test: Repeat with proof endpoint based on plumpness, lighter feel and slow finger recovery rather than elapsed minutes.

result_b_hydration_flour.test: Keep flour brand and proofing constant; make one measured hydration correction rather than adding flour by feel.

result_b_structure.test: Keep formula constant and change only kneading/development endpoint until dough is smooth and cohesive.

result_b_mixed.test: Use the historical batch data to select the stronger observation-supported branch; do not change flour and proofing together.

result_beta_gummy.message: Wet/gummy interior is not yet supported strongly enough for commercial ranking. Collect steaming-time, wrapper-thickness and filling-moisture evidence first.

result_beta_large_holes.message: Uneven large-hole diagnosis remains beta. Potential branches include trapped shaping bubbles and fermentation/structure issues.

result_c_overproof.test: Keep recipe and steaming unchanged; steam a comparison batch at an earlier final-proof endpoint.

result_c_transition_conflicted.test: After proofing is controlled, compare equivalent buns with immediate opening vs ~3-minute covered rest. Keep every other variable unchanged.

hypotheses.cause: filling moisture / thin wrapper support issue

result_c_filling_support.test: Keep dough/proofing constant and reduce only filling moisture/load or increase wrapper center support in a small comparison batch.

result_d_overproof.test: Steam an earlier-proof comparison batch with all other variables unchanged.

hypotheses.cause: surface drying / shaping bubbles / aggressive steam

result_d_surface_process.test: Choose the strongest observed clue: cover shaped buns if skin dried, or stabilize steam intensity if heat was aggressive. Change one only.

result_e_condensation.test: Keep formula/proofing constant. Change only condensation control using a safe cloth-wrapped metal lid or equivalent bamboo-steamer setup.

result_e_filling_beta.test: Run a small comparison with filling moisture/load as the single changed variable.

result_e_unknown.message: No high-confidence moisture cause identified. Ask for exact location, timing, steamer type and filling/wrapper details before recommending a fix.

result_f_intentional_crack.message: Cracking can be intentional in Cantonese-style char siu bao. Diagnose only if the crack pattern differs from the intended style.

result_f_beta.message: Smooth/closed bao cracking needs style-specific evidence before commercial ranking. Current candidate branches: proofing, surface drying/tension, wrapper geometry and seal/filling load.
